scope_notes: Mentor v3.6 owns long-run S0/B0, candidate universes, client constraints and project state; it does not decide current-run per-asset deployment sizes.

V70_2.html is the executable tactical small-knob source: it receives S0/B0, computes macro-driven C and T, and outputs only total equity, total bond and V70_ORIGINAL_DRY_POWDER budgets. It must not select individual stocks or bonds.
V82 owns stock/equity-ETF security-level execution; BondV75 owns bond/bond-ETF security-level selection, sizing and deployment.
Mentor v3.6 explicitly forbids hardcoding SGOV 50% or any other current-run bond weight. Earlier fixed 50/35/15 and 80/20 values are not Mentor-owned formal current-run weights.
SGOV_BOND_BUCKET and SGOV_DRY_POWDER_BUCKET share ticker SGOV but are separate accounting roles and must never be double-counted.
Candidate examples are a generic research starting universe, not mandatory holdings. Client-specific preferred/existing assets require a separate client snapshot when backtested.
This lock records the current Mentor architecture for reproducibility and does not alter the formal strategy rules.
